description: List Facebook pixels for a selected business during community tracking setup. Business and community refer to the same thing and are interchangeable. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

businessId.description: Facebook (Meta) Business Manager ID that owns the pixel.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

facebookAccessToken.description: Facebook user access token from the Facebook login step.

name: list_community_facebook_business_pixels
title: List Business Facebook Business Pixels
